<!--
  How it works: numbered or icon steps in a row or a column. Axes: layout (row, column), marker (number, icon),
  align, density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";

  export type StepsListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    steps: Step[];
    layout?: "row" | "column";
    marker?: "number" | "icon";
    align?: "start" | "center";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import IconBadge from "../primitives/iconbadge/icon-badge.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    steps,
    layout = "row",
    marker = "number",
    align = "start",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: StepsListProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  align={align}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "row") ? "default" : "2xl")}
>
  <List
    tag="ol"
    class={cn("grid gap-6", (((layout as string) === "row") ? "sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4" : ""))}
    data-testid="items"
  >
    {#each steps as step, i (step.id)}
      <ListItem
        class={cn(
          "flex gap-4",
          (((layout as string) === "row") ? "flex-col" : ""),
          (((align as string) === "center") ? "items-center text-center" : "")
        )}
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <IconBadge variant="primary" data-slot="marker">
          {#if ((marker as string) === "icon")}
            <LucideIcon name={step.icon} size={20} />
          {:else}
            <Text size="base" weight="bold">
              {((i + 1) == null ? undefined : String((i + 1)))}
            </Text>
          {/if}
        </IconBadge>
        <Stack gap="2" align={(((align as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}>
          <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
            {step.title}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {step.text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
</SectionFrame>
